probes.check: am_probe_jolt_jobs(): one PhysicsSystem::Update with a falling sphere above a floor; the jobs interface's jolt submission count rises.

seeded_violation.description: Construct JPH::JobSystemThreadPool in place of the adapter, so Jolt runs its jobs on its own threads.

adaptation_notes: The adapter derives from JPH::JobSystemWithBarrier and submits each Jolt job to am::jobs; GetMaxConcurrency is the interface's worker count plus the calling thread.
The adapter counts jobs in flight and its destructor, which am_unbind_jolt_jobs() runs, waits for the count to reach zero: a worker can still be releasing a Jolt job after Update returns.

Jolt orders a job's free after other threads' use of it with an atomic fence, which ThreadSanitizer doesn't model when the last release happens inside the uninstrumented library; the adapter's FreeJob makes the ordering explicit with an acq_rel operation every worker releases to, so the jobs.tsan-clean run sees it.
Translation units that derive from Jolt classes compile with -fno-rtti (MSVC /GR-); Jolt's build fragment sets this on the glue target.
